items.item: The matrix is a real table with row and column headers; every checkbox has an accessible name combining module and action
items.evidence: <table aria-label="Permissions for role ..."> with <th scope="col"> for Module/All/View/Create/Edit/Delete/Approve and <th scope="row"> per module and group. Every checkbox goes through cb() with aria-label like "Orders – View", "Sales – Edit (all Sales modules)", "Edit – all modules". Non-applicable cells carry sr-only "X – Action not applicable".

items.item: Rows or columns can be toggled in bulk, with an indeterminate state when partially selected
items.evidence: Column-header, per-module, per-group and global "All" checkboxes use data-keys; applyToggle() sets many keys; syncMatrix() sets i.indeterminate = (state==='mixed'). Screenshot shows indeterminate dashes on All/View/Create/Edit/Delete/Approve headers and on Sales.

items.item: Changes use an explicit save with a visible unsaved-changes indicator and a warning when leaving
items.evidence: Sticky #bar with Cancel and Save; renderBar() shows amber dot + "Unsaved changes · N changes" (otherwise "No unsaved changes"). window beforeunload handler when isDirty(); guardDirty() dialog "Discard N unsaved changes to ...?" on role switch and side-nav clicks. Risky saves get a review dialog.

items.item: System or locked roles are read-only and say why
items.evidence: Owner/Administrator have r.locked text; syncMatrix() disables all checkboxes (i.disabled = !!r.locked); lock banner shows the reason plus "Use Duplicate role to make an editable copy"; bar says "... is a system role, so its permissions can't be changed." Save/Cancel disabled with aria-describedby=barNote. System roles have no Delete menu item.

items.item: Deleting a role asks for confirmation naming the role and how many users it affects
items.evidence: deleteDlg(): title "Delete role ${name}?", body "${users} users will lose these permissions. This can't be undone.", required replacement-role select, buttons "Keep role" / "Delete role"; entry via per-row Actions menu.

items.item: The screen shows who last changed the role and when, or links to its audit history
items.evidence: auditStamp(): "Last changed by Lê Hoa on 04/11/2026 15:58 · View history" under the role heading (visible in screenshot); "Last changed" column in role list; historyDlg() lists when/who/what with permission diffs.

items.item: All controls are keyboard operable and pointer targets are at least 24px
items.evidence: All controls are native button/input/a/select/dialog with focus-visible rings; overflow menu handles Arrow/Escape/Tab; skip link present; dialogs via showModal. Checkboxes are 16px but wrapped in labels h-10 w-full (40px) / h-12; buttons h-8 (32px); audit smallTargets: 0 over 144 targets. Minor: row click-to-select is mouse-only, but a keyboard button exists in the Role cell.

notes: Clean, restrained admin UI: no greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, emoji, promo card, hover-lift or oversized radius (radii 4 and 6). Sidebar is light slate with a single blue accent. Group labels in the sidebar are small sentence-case, not tracked uppercase. The NA avatar is the real signed-in user, not a non-person. Type badges are neutral grey with a grey dot, not rainbow status. Automated audit score 100 with no violations. Extras: loading, error, empty, save-failure states (?state=error|empty|savefail), dependency messaging (Edit needs View), and a dependency live region.
